captions.detailed: A cargo bike front assembly featuring a blue-painted steel unicrown fork with curved blades. A large, flat black cargo platform is mounted horizontally in front of the fork, supported by thin struts. Above the fork crown, a black head tube houses a vertical steerer tube, which connects to a riser stem holding wide, flat black handlebars with matching grips. The steering mechanism rotates on a continuous revolute axis along the head-tube centerline.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a cargo bike front fork and steering assembly. It must feature a curved blue fork, a front-mounted black cargo rack platform, a vertical steerer tube with a black head tube, and wide flat handlebars attached via a riser stem, allowing continuous revolute steering rotation.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed using an ArticulatedObject builder. The fixed frame portion consists of a black cylindrical head tube. The rotating steering assembly (child) is defined as a separate part containing a vertical cylindrical steerer tube, a rectangular block fork crown, curved cylindrical fork blades, a flat box-based cargo rack with supports, a riser stem, and a horizontal handlebar cylinder with end grips. A continuous articulation joint is defined along the vertical Z-axis to connect the head tube to the steering assembly.
